name: Worrying About End Times
overview: Scripture encourages believers not to be consumed by anxiety about the end times but to trust in God's unchanging nature and providential care. The psalmist reminds us that the LORD is our shepherd who provides for all our needs and shelters us under His protection. Jesus teaches us to avoid worry about daily necessities, emphasizing faith over fear, as seen when He rebuked His disciples for their little faith. God's steadfastness assures us that, despite uncertain times, His sovereign plan remains firm and His people will not be forsaken.
